item.title: India: AI Initiatives Pave the Way for Global Leadership
item.description: India’s regional and pre-Summit AI initiatives in Rajasthan and Assam are actively driving innovation, workforce readiness, and responsible AI adoption nationwide, effectively ahead of the 2026 India AI Impact Summit.

item.title: Australia: Multi-Level Approach to AI Innovation and Deployment
item.description: Australia is steadily and proactively advancing AI through state-level applications, a comprehensive national strategy and global collaboration, ensuring innovation, ethical oversight and widespread societal benefits.

item.title: Vietnam: Digital Technology Industry Surpasses 2025 Growth Targets
item.description: Vietnam’s digital technology industry exceeded its 2025 targets with strong revenue, export and e-commerce growth, reinforcing its role as a key driver of sustained national economic expansion.

item.title: Hong Kong: Shared Supercomputing Infrastructure Boosts AI Ecosystem
item.description: Hong Kong’s AI Subsidy Scheme expands access to supercomputing, accelerating research, model development and applications while supporting efficient, scalable innovation.

item.title: India: Human Capital Strategies Shape an Inclusive AI Future
item.description: The Human Capital Working Group Meeting is shaping India’s human-centric AI strategy, focusing on workforce readiness, education reform and inclusive innovation ahead of the India AI Impact Summit 2026.

item.title: Malaysia: Smart Tech Transforms Selangor Aerospace Ecosystem
item.description: Selangor advances aerospace ecosystem with automation, robotics and IoT, strengthening supply chains, boosting skilled workforce and supporting technology-driven industrial growth.

item.title: The Philippines: Bicol Pilots Digital Civil Service Exam
item.description: Bicol is leveraging digital initiatives like the CS DEX, QR geotagging system and SPICY to modernise public services, expand opportunities and create more inclusive, efficient and citizen-focused solutions.

item.title: Hong Kong: CUHK’s Smart Enzyme Innovation Platform
item.description: CUHK has developed a smart enzyme innovation platform that leverages bioengineering and self-assembling catalysts to enable scalable, low-waste, cost-efficient and environmentally friendly industrial chemical production.

item.title: Vietnam: Digital Transformation, Innovation Catalyse Growth
item.description: Vietnam is leveraging advanced technology, AI and digital innovation to drive a new phase of economic growth, industrialisation and modernisation while embedding innovation into enterprise culture nationwide.

item.title: Singapore Polytechnic Showcases Future-Ready Education
item.description: Singapore Polytechnic’s Open House 2026 offers hands-on digital, AI and data-driven learning experiences, highlighting student innovation, entrepreneurship and industry-relevant skills for a future-ready workforce.
